adaptation.inapplicable_observable: The C++ Luau fork compiler selecting FASTCALL bytecode versus lua_vec2d C-binding dispatch as separately inspectable native routes.
adaptation.rationale: The pure-Rust Luaur backend does not expose the C++ fork FASTCALL/C-binding route identity. The exact pinned program still drives its corresponding static, namecall, and indirect production routes and asserts all runtime-observable results agree.
